name: Mini Porta Cabin
description:
Mini Porta Cabin — The Compact End of the SAMAN Range

A mini porta cabin is the smallest practical footprint we build for guard posts, gate offices, ticket counters and tight-access sites — a fully finished MS cabin where a standard site office is simply too large. It uses the same welded IS 2062 mild-steel frame and finished interior as our larger cabins, sized down to what a compact deployment actually needs, starting at 10×10 ft.

Which Size for Which Application — the Compact End of the Range

The right mini cabin comes from the application, not a preference. A 10×10 ft (100 sq ft) is the workhorse: a seated guard post with a desk, a visitor position and turn-room, a weighbridge cabin, a ticket or toll counter with a service window. A 20×8 ft slim unit suits boundary-wall and road-margin placements where depth is the constraint — one long, narrow, fully usable room. A 20×10 ft is the compact site office: one to four occupants with desks and storage, still quick to place and relocate. Every size above that keeps the same compact character with more floor — the full ladder runs to 40×12 ft for buyers who want mini-range simplicity at scale. If your requirement is genuinely smaller than 10×10 ft — a standing-only booth at a gate or kiosk-scale unit — that is a different product class: see our security cabins range, which is purpose-built at booth scale. The mini porta cabin range starts where a working desk starts: 10×10 ft.

MS Corrugated Steel at Compact Scale — Why It Matters at a Gate

A compact cabin at a building entrance or estate gate is touched, brushed and knocked every day of its service life, and that is why the material decision matters most at exactly this scale. Three points make IS 2062 MS corrugated steel the right skin for a permanent gate cabin. First, impact: 18-gauge corrugated MS deflects and dents at contact — a barrier arm, a brushing bumper, a door pushed hard — where thin FRP cracks, and a cracked panel on a customer-facing gate cabin looks abandoned within a couple of years. Second, repairability: MS wall panels are small, local sections a fabricator can cut out and replace individually in hours at minor cost; a cracked FRP shell at this scale cannot be patched without specialist work. Third, lifespan: IS 2062 MS with factory surface treatment and routine repainting serves 20+ years at a permanently manned, high-contact post. For the full steel-grade, frame and treatment detail, see our MS porta cabin page.

Standard Fitout in a 10×10 Mini Cabin — What Fits

Every SAMAN mini cabin leaves the factory finished: insulated walls and roof under the corrugated MS shell, pre-laminated lined interior, vinyl-finished floor, one aluminium sliding window with safety grill on each long face, a lockable MS entry door, LED lighting, socket points on a mini distribution board, and an AC provision. In a 10×10 the practical layout is one standard desk, two chairs, a register shelf and a monitor or handset — a full working post, not a shell. Nothing about the compact size reduces the specification: the frame, insulation and finish match our largest cabins; you are simply not paying for floor you don't need.

When to Step Up — and When Not To

Choose 10×10 while the cabin serves one seated occupant plus a visitor. Move to 20×8 when the site gives you length but not depth. Move to 20×10 when a second permanent workstation arrives. If the cabin's real job is a working office for a small team rather than a post, compare the small portacabin — the compact OFFICE end of the range — before sizing up further. And if the deciding factor is budget alone, the value-spec compact cabin carries this same 10×10 footprint at the keenest finish tier. Every mini cabin is delivered and installed across South and North India, typically in 7–21 working days, with welded lifting lugs for relocation as your gate, site or season moves. Explore SAMAN's porta cabin range for the complete ladder, or send your application and we will confirm the right compact size at quotation.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a mini porta cabin used for?

Guard posts, gate offices, toll/ticket counters, weighbridge cabins and tight-access sites — anywhere a full site office is too large. Fully finished MS cabin, quick to place and relocate.

What does a mini porta cabin cost?

From ₹1,34,000 (10×10) ex-GST, HSN 9406, 18% GST extra. It's the same build as our larger cabins, sized down — you pay for less floor, not lower quality.

How is a mini porta cabin different from a security cabin?

A mini porta cabin is a compact general-purpose cabin; for purpose-built guard booths see our security cabins. Many buyers use a mini cabin as a guard post.

Can it be relocated?

Yes — welded lifting lugs; the compact MS unit is built to be lifted and re-sited.

Sizes and delivery?

Compact sizes from 10×10 ft; delivered across South & North India in 7–21 working days.
